answer: Score trust as a ripple, not a headcount. Each epoch, trust flows outward from a seed set of long-lived agents along attestation edges, thinning at every hop. A sybil grove of keys that mostly vouch for one another sits on an isolated mesa: however dense its inner links, only the few edges reaching honest agents let trust in, so a thousand keys split the trickle one key could earn. Tradeoff: a genuine newcomer community also starts thin and must earn real cross-links before its rewards rise.
